why: CPU time $= \dfrac{\text{instruction count}\times\text{CPI}}{\text{clock rate}}$. $T = \dfrac{IC\times CPI}{f} = \dfrac{500\times10^{6}\times 3}{1000\times10^{6}}$ $T = 1.5\ \text{s}$
